summary: Compute one near-target EM eigenpair and shared unit-Hermitian electric normalization with physical field-state diagnostics.

identity.relation: Near-target electromagnetic eigenpair and field gauge
identity.definition: Request one sparse EM eigenpair of M at the stored-kernel target (frequency_guess/wcs1)*wcs1+1e-8i rad/s. Extract last6components; normalize the Hermitian E norm, apply a common scale/phase to B and choose the largest represented E component real nonnegative (first exact tie). UE=epsilon0|E|^2/2 and UB=|B|^2/(2mu0). d=diag(D) owns the newly computed frequency.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: NativeResult or its state mapping produced by the named predecessor. Scalar numeric fields are usually1x1 native arrays; row/column singleton dimensions are retained. Scientific numeric transport is float64/complex128; inactive fields are empty arrays, never fabricated zeros.
inputs.units: mixed; physical dimensions recorded by state fields
inputs.constraints: Must contain the complete compatible predecessor state; handcrafted inconsistent fields are outside the qualified composition.

inputs.name: frequency_guess
inputs.description: Dimensional finite complex scalar near-target frequency.
inputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: D
outputs.description: Actual eigenvalue, also exposed in d and omega.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: UE
outputs.description: Electric energy density under the chosen unit electric amplitude.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

outputs.name: UB
outputs.description: Magnetic energy density under the same amplitude convention.
outputs.constraints: Compatible typed scientific predecessor; native singleton dimensions are retained and inactive fields remain empty arrays.

preconditions: EM matrix state with M,NN,iem=1,wcs1,epsilon0,mu0; finite scalar complex frequency_guess.
supported: One sparse EM eigenpair, with sp1,nw1,iout2,icalp1 controlled internally; actual normalization shared by the polarization graph.
excluded: Zero-electric modes under this amplitude convention.
A unique physical branch or a complete eigenbasis.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError with retained result and receipt when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: Small wheel-only example using packaged native resources and raw Octave; no source checkout or network.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
deck=np.array([[1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0],[-1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0.]])
controls=dict(B0=1e-7,N=1,J=4,sp=0,iem=1,iout=2,ipa=3,ipb=3,iloga=0,ilogb=0,pa1=.2,pa2=.4,dpa=.1)
eq=m.initialize_equilibrium(deck,controls=controls,par=[.2,0,.2,0,0,0])
point=m.electromagnetic_matrix(eq,kx=0.,kz=.2/float(eq.state['cwp'].item()))
s=m.eigensolve(point)
values=np.asarray(s.state['d']).ravel()
r=m.reconstruct_point_fields(point,frequency_guess=values[np.argmax(values.real)])
assert abs(np.sum(abs(r.state['dEB'].ravel()[:3])**2)-1)<1e-12
example.expected: Assertions succeed for a compatible installation with Octave. This demonstrates the declared operation, not global scientific or visual acceptance.

scope: Shared production normalizer independently tested for zero Ex, phase transformations, SI energy and domain failures.
Actual point facade is checked against M V=V D and the normalized Maxwell/Faraday row; final public-wheel execution remains required.

Point eigenpair normwise backward gate ||M V - V D||_F / (||M||_F ||V||_F + ||V D||_F) <= 1e-9; the independent physical Maxwell/Faraday row uses ||k cross E - omega B||_2/(||k||_2 ||E||_2 + |omega| ||B||_2) <= 1e-7 for nonzero k. These are residual checks, not forward-error or mode-uniqueness guarantees.
